Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Crawford
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/11/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 471 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Agriculture Fund by $28,805.36 per year by increasing the annual salary of the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries from $87,194.64, currently, to $110,000, effective January 2023. This bill also provides that the commissioner shall be entitled to any cost-of-living pay increases and other benefits granted to state employees.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Crawford
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/16/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 471 as amended and reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would increase the obligations of the Agriculture Fund by $22,805.36 per year by increasing the annual salary of the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries from $87,194.64, currently, to $110,000, effective January 2023. This bill also provides that the commissioner shall be entitled to any cost-of-living pay increases and other benefits granted to state employees, and any cost-of-living granted would be treated as an expense allowance during the incumbent's term and subsequently incorporated into the salary of the commissioner upon the next term of office.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
